# Vision+

## Without Vision+, what can you see?

Like you, we view even a single fatality as catastrophic. You’ll understand then how our goal, our Mission Zero, is to completely and sustainably eradicate fatalities from the workplace. To help achieve that, we created Vision+, a cutting-edge solution designed to revolutionise workplace safety across high-risk industries.

Every second it works to ensure the safety of your team. Let Vision+ be your eyes, instantly alerting you of unsafe conditions and worker behaviour across a range of high-risk activities.

[Download Vision+ Brochure](https://forwoodsafety.com/solutions/vision/#form)

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/shutterstock_230318539-checked-licensed-scaled.jpg)

## How does it work?

Vision+ utilises computer vision and AI to monitor unsafe behaviour 24 hours a day, seven days a week. It never blinks. Vision+ integrates up to four camera streams per high-risk work zone to calculate different risk hazards. Our advanced AI accurately detects and assesses potential red flags, prioritising safety during high-risk activities such as loading, lifting and working at height operations.

There’s more to it, of course. Take a look at our key features below.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/vision-1.png)

## Key features

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Object Detection and Motion Assessment

Utilises advanced AI models to identify all objects within the video stream to determine, for example, if a load is in motion or static on the ground.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Comprehensive Safety Coverage

Addresses gravity related risks such as lifting, loading, and working at heights, applicable to multiple industries such as construction, manufacturing, energy, and mining.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Critical Control Expertise

Vision+ applies learnings from Forwood’s 10+ years industry experience, building and refining critical control management programs in high-risk environments. It monitors mature critical controls for high potential risks through constant video streams.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Timely Web and App Notifications

If the Vision+ algorithms identify potential at-risk events, predefined workflows are triggered within the system, sending notifications in the mobile app and web applications. This plays a pivotal role in promptly notifying responsible individuals, facilitating swift action to risk areas.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Extended Safety Coverage

The drop zone is projected out at 30 degrees to the sides of the moving load accounting for the possibility of the load falling within an extended diameter. This ensures comprehensive coverage in loading zones, by recognising when required safe distances are not adhered to.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Wide Angle Camera Considerations

Our advanced algorithms account for variations in the vertical trajectory of moving loads introduced by wide angle cameras. This provides accurate calculations of the drop zone, even in complex camera environments.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/check_circle_40dp_FILL1_wght400_GRAD0_opsz40.png)

### Confidentiality Guarantee

Vision+ respects customer data putting utmost importance into confidentiality by ensuring compliance with privacy standards. Utilising Amazon Web Services infrastructure, the most trusted cloud services provider, you’ll have peace of mind knowing your sensitive information is safe and secure.
